        <meta name="citation_title" content="Envision: Cartographies of Risk in Lubbock">
        <meta name="citation_publication_date" content="2022-12-01T02:37:05.773145">
        <meta name="citation_doi" content="10.17603/ds2-ye2p-8y77">
        <meta name="citation_description" content="Envision is part of the outreach and education strategy of the project-led RED Lab titled "Improving Knowledge about NWS Forecaster Core Partner Needs for Reducing Vulnerability to Compound Threats in Landfalling Tropical Cyclones Amid Covid-19" (NOAA grant NA 210AR4590214). 
Envision emerges from the question of how to represent the history of a city while mapping social and environmental risks and hazards? On November 4 and 11, students of Estacado and Frenship High Schools in Lubbock (TX) participated in the workshop "Envision: Cartographies of Risk in Lubbock" (hereafter, Envision) to solve this challenging question with two different groups during a full-day journey consisting of a morning exploring the city Downtown, historical places, and an air quality lab on campus, followed by an afternoon of social cartography activities with digital and analog maps of the city. The pedagogical material resulting from this project can be used to inspire other scholars and communities to take their own steps to produce social catographies in order to understand social and environmental risks.">

    ];
    const pathsToPDFs = [
        /\.pdf/
    ];
    // NOTE: Some links have `target="_blank"` even though they should not
    const pathsOfManualNewTabLinks = document.querySelectorAll(
        '[target="_blank"]:not([aria-describedby])'
    );

    /** Adds accessibility attribute to links that open in new tab */
    function supportA11y( link ) {
        const hasA11yNote = link.querySelector('span.sr-only');
        const hasA11yDesc = link.hasAttribute('aria-describedby');

        if ( ! hasA11yNote && ! hasA11yDesc ) {
            link.setAttribute('aria-describedby', 'msg-open-new-window');
            if (window.DEBUG) {
                console.debug(`Link ${link} now has "aria-describedby"`);
            }
        }
    }

    /* To make certain links open in new window, and apply a11y attribute */
    findLinksAndSetTargets({
        pathsToForceSetTarget: [
            ...pathsToRedirectsToExternal,
            ...pathsToPDFs
        ],
        setTargetCallback: supportA11y,
    });

    /* To apply a11y attribute to manual new tab links */
    [ ...pathsOfManualNewTabLinks ].forEach( supportA11y );
</script><!-- https://medium.com/@svinkle/why-let-someone-know-when-a-link-opens-a-new-window-8699d20ed3b1#79b2 -->
